title: Ask about your data
lead: Anyone may ask what Aveline holds about their email address, or ask for it to be corrected or erased. You don’t need an account.

kind.EXPORT: A copy of what is held about me
kind.ERASURE: Erase what is held about me
kind.RECTIFICATION: Correct what is held about me

emailHelp: We’ll check it’s yours before answering.
notesHelp: For a correction, say what should change. Up to 2,000 characters.
sent: We’ve recorded your request. We’ll check who you are and answer by {{date}}, Yerevan time.
sameAnswer: This message is the same whether or not anything is held about that address.

errors.refused: The request wasn’t accepted. Check what you typed and try again.

placeholder.title: This is a placeholder.
placeholder.body: Before Aveline launches, this notice will be rewritten and reviewed by a lawyer. Don’t rely on it until then.

who.title: Who is responsible
who.body: Aveline runs this service and is responsible for the personal data it holds.

what.title: What we hold
what.body: Hosts’ accounts and their teams; the guest lists hosts give us, and the replies, answers and agreements guests send; ticket orders and their holders; and the photos guests choose to share.

why.title: Why
why.body: To send invitations, take replies, sell tickets and run the event for the hosts who invited you, and nothing else.

whoSees.title: Who sees it
whoSees.body: The hosts of an event and their team, each as their role allows. A vendor sees only what the hosts chose to share with them, never your contact details unless shared.

howLong.title: How long
howLong.body: For as long as the event’s invitation stays open, then as the hosts’ plan sets. You can ask for your data to be erased at any time.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: You may ask what we hold about your email address, and ask for it to be corrected or erased. You don’t need an account.
